disposition_reason: Abdulsalam et al. 2025 (JASEM 29(9)) measured Cd, Pb, Cr and As by AAS in 12 ready-to-eat pre-packaged foods from one Ilorin supermarket (oats, Goldenmorn, yoghurt, milk, sausage, shawarma bread, chips, cookies, cakes, canned fruit, vegetables, sardines). No cocoa or chocolate product was analysed; chocolate appears only in a discussion citation of Hands et al. 2024.
disposition_locator: Materials and Method p.173-174; Results and Discussion p.174-176 (Hands et al. 2024 citation)

study.design: market survey with health risk assessment
study.growing_origin_vs_market: one supermarket, Ilorin south LGA, Kwara State, Nigeria

notes: Secondary citation only: Hands et al. 2024 (72 dark chocolate and cocoa products, USA) reported 43% of chocolate samples exceeded Pb limits and 35% Cd limits; use the primary Hands paper, not this citation.
